info.description: # **API Documentation for News and Journalist Management** ## **Author Information** **Prepared By**: **Name**: Anggun Caksono **Internship Role**: Full-Stack Developer **Project Title**: Portal Berita **Organization**: PT Winnicode Garuda Teknologi **Purpose**: This documentation is prepared as part of my final internship project to demonstrate the development and management of an API for news and journalist operations. --- ## **Introduction** This API allows for the management of news articles and journalist profiles. It includes features for login, adding new journalists, creating news articles, and sending automated emails with attachments. Below are the detailed instructions for using the endpoints. --- ## **1\. Login** **Endpoint**: `POST http://localhost:3000/auth/login` **Description**: Login to get the authentication token required for accessing secured endpoints. ### **Request Body (JSON)**: ``` json { "email": "son@gmail.com", "password": "12345678" } ``` ### **Steps**: 1. Open Postman and select the `Auth` folder. 2. Choose the `Login` request or directly input the URL. 3. Set the request method to `POST`. 4. In the `Body` tab, select `raw` and set the type to `JSON`. 5. Paste the above JSON body and send the request. ### **Response Example**: ``` json { "token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..." } ``` **Important**: Copy the `token` value from the response and use it as a Bearer Token for all secured API requests. --- ## **2\. Add a New Journalist** **Endpoint**: `POST http://localhost:3000/journalist/add` **Description**: Adds a new journalist to the system and sends an automated email to the registered journalist containing their account details. The email includes: - Account details (Name, Phone, Email, Default Password) - A screenshot of the email content as an attachment. ### **Request Headers**: - Authorization: Bearer ### **Request Body (JSON)**: ``` json { "email": "emailanda@gmail.com", "name": "Penulis", "phone": "+628763048336" } ``` ### **Steps**: 1. Ensure you have the Bearer Token copied from the login response. 2. Open the `Journalist` folder and choose the `Add Journalist` request or directly input the URL. 3. Set the request method to `POST`. 4. In the `Body` tab, select `raw` and set the type to `JSON`. 5. Paste the above JSON body and send the request. **Notes**: - The phone number must be in international format (`+`). ### **Response Example**: ``` json { "message": "Journalist successfully created and added to Firestore. Email has been sent.", "name": "Penulis", "phone": "+628763048336", "email": "emailanda@gmail.com", "password": "12345678" } ``` ### **Email Example**: The journalist will receive an email with the following content: --- ## **3\. Add a New News Article** **Endpoint**: `POST http://localhost:3000/news` **Description**: Adds a new news article to the system. ### **Request Headers**: - Authorization: Bearer ### **Request Body (Form-Data)**: | Key | Type | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `title` | `text` | Title of the news article | | `content` | `text` | Content of the news article | | `category` | `text` | News category (e.g., Sports) | | `thumbnail` | `file` | Thumbnail image for the article | ### **Steps**: 1. Ensure you have the Bearer Token copied from the login response. 2. Open the `News` folder and choose the `Add News` request or directly input the URL. 3. Set the request method to `POST`. 4. In the `Body` tab, select `form-data` and fill in the keys and values as described above. 5. Attach a file for the `thumbnail` key (e.g., a sample image). ### **Response Example**: ``` json { "message": "News created successfully", "data": { "id": "12345", "title": "Breaking News", "content": "This is the content of the news article.", "category": "Sports", "thumbnailURL": "https://example.com/thumbnail.jpg", "author": "Author Name", "createdAt": "2024-11-19T10:00:00Z" } } ``` --- ### Notes: - **Automated Email**: Emails sent when adding a new journalist include their account details and a screenshot of the email for documentation purposes. - **Authorization**: Always include the Bearer Token in the `Authorization` header for secured endpoints. - **Testing**: For email verification, ensure you have SMTP configured (e.g., Gmail or Mailtrap). ## **Acknowledgment** This API documentation is part of my final internship project. I would like to thank my mentors, team members, and \[Organization Name\] for their guidance and support throughout the development process. Feel free to reach out if you have any questions or need further clarification!

### Update Info

This endpoint is used to modify an existing piece of data by sending a PUT request with the identifier included in the URL.

#### Request Body
- Type: JSON
- Description: Payload should include the `name` field with the updated value.

Example:
```json
{
  "name": "Updated name"
}
```

#### Response
The response for this request is a JSON schema, which defines the structure of the response data.

This endpoint makes an HTTP GET request to retrieve the details of a news article that has been successfully posted. The request does not contain a request body, as it is a simple GET request to fetch information.

The response will include the details of the posted news article, such as the title, content, author, publication date, and any other relevant information. The response body will provide the necessary details about the successfully posted news article.

This endpoint makes an HTTP GET request to retrieve news articles from the "Tes kedua" category. The request does not include a request body as it is a GET request, and the response will contain the news articles from the specified category.

### Delete News

This endpoint is used to delete a specific news item.

#### Request Body

- title (string, required): The title of the news item to be deleted.
- content (string, required): The content of the news item to be deleted.
    

#### Response

The response for this request is a JSON schema. The schema includes the properties and data types of the response object, which will be returned upon successful deletion of the news item.

# Update News Category

This endpoint is used to update the category of news.

## Request

- Method: PATCH
- URL: `{{host}}news/category`
- Headers:
    - Content-Type: application/json
- Body:
    - oldCategory (string, required): The current category of the news.
    - newCategory (string, required): The new category to be assigned to the news.

## Response

The response for this request is a JSON object with the following schema:

``` json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    // Define the properties of the response JSON schema here
  }
}

 ```

### Add Journalist
This endpoint allows you to add a new journalist to the system.

#### Request Body
- email (string, required): The email address of the journalist.
- name (string, required): The name of the journalist.
- phone (string, required): The phone number of the journalist.

Example:
```json
{
  "email": "78alrescha@gmail.com",
  "name": "Penulis",
  "phone": "+628763048336"
}
```

#### Response
A successful request returns a `200 OK` or `201 Created` response code.
